title: Pirelli Velo tyre catalogue (United Kingdom)
notes: UK catalogue read 2026-11-01 lists P ZERO Race TLR SL-R, P ZERO Race, Race TLR RS, Race RS, Race TLR, Race 4S, Race TLR 4S, Race TT, P ZERO Road and Road TLR, Cinturato Evo, Road, Road TLR and Sport, and P7 Sport, with a dealer finder. The US catalogue path for P ZERO Race TLR returned "page not found" on the same day.
